create_activation_Sigmoid: create a Sigmoid activation module that applies sigmoid to sparse tensor features
create_activation_ReLU: create a ReLU activation module that applies relu to sparse tensor features
create_activation_LeakyReLU: create a LeakyReLU activation module with configurable leak parameter for sparse tensor features
create_activation_Tanh: create a Tanh activation module that applies tanh to sparse tensor features
create_activation_ELU_SELU: create ELU and SELU activation modules that apply elu and selu to sparse tensor features
